source.author: berlinnaijafoodie
source.text:
My Birthday is tomorrow and 
Buffet Sunday already looking like a full house💃

The Buffet Sunday Experience Birthday Edition is set, and it’s already shaping up to be something special.

A full spread of proper Nigerian flavours from jollof, soups, sides, proteins, small chops and chef-curated surprise birthday specials all in one space, with good people for just 35€

Because we like our guests comfortability, this will be a batch dining experience.

Sunday, March 22
Dining Sessions: 1st Batch: 1:30pm – 3:00pm

2nd Batch: 3:30pm – 5:00pm

3rd Batch: 5:30pm – 7:00pm
Adults: 35€
Kids: 20€

Seats are limited and reservations are already coming in steadily.
If you know, you know😉

Send a DM or WhatsApp message to secure your spot.

Olayinka
Founder, Berlin Naija Foodie
.
.
#allyoucaneatberlin #allyoucaneat  #nigerianmeals #goodfoodgoodmood  #africanrestaurantinberlin

reference.notes: Alexanderplatz is a square, not a place; all claims go to Berlin Naija Foodie. The birthday buffet is a dated event with its own prices, so the 35€ and 20€ prices could be deal, fact or event, and the batch dining claim could be space, crowding or atmosphere.

match.note: The post is by the venue's own account and names it exactly, and the brand has a single branch; the Alexanderplatz tag reads as a generic city tag rather than an address that contradicts Baumschulenstraße.
